name: relativeTransform | Developer Docs
snippet: relativeTransform. The position of a node relative to its containing parent as a Transform matrix. Not used for scaling, see width and height instead.

name: rotation | Developer Docs
snippet: The rotation of the node in degrees. Returns values from -180 to 180. Identical to Math.atan2(-m10, m00) in the relativeTransform matrix.
